label: Telegram continuous downtime alerts
info: Requires snapshot connector on the actual downtime timer tab. Set DOWNTIME_ALERT_ENABLED=true and TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN. Managers only. Read telegram-downtime-alerts.README.md.

name: Continuous stop + interval/recovery alerts
Safe error and unlock
func: const store=env.get('DOWNTIME_ALERT_CONTEXT_STORE')||undefined; if(flow.get('telegramDowntimeAlertLock',store)?.id===msg.dt?.id)flow.set('telegramDowntimeAlertLock',null,store);return {payload:{ok:false,description:'Downtime alert request failed. Check MongoDB, bot token and connectivity. Delivery lease expires in five minutes.'}};
